thread:
Sam (SRE): Heads up — we keep seeing postmortem actions age out. Proposal: single Action Queue with SLA labels, auto-ticketing from PM template, and weekly triage. Thoughts?
Priya (PM): Strong agree. Add required fields: owner, due_date (auto by severity), verification_steps, recurrence_tag.
Eli (Oncall): Suggest escalation rule: unowned after 48h -> ping IC; overdue -> escalate weekly to manager.
Noor (Infra): Can we add a runbook_update flag so infra changes force a docs update before close?
Sam (SRE): Yes. Also add a small "cost_estimate" field (downtime mins/customers affected) to help prioritization.
ops-bot: Ops Bot: created ticket OPS-998 from postmortem "cache-thundering" assigned to oncall-rotation due 2026-04-05.
Priya (PM): For recurrence detection: match on service + error signature + stack hash. If recurrence_score >= 3 within 30d, surface in monthly deep-dive.
Eli (Oncall): Let's run a 30m weekly triage (rotate facilitator between oncall and SRE lead) to clear or escalate stale actions.
Sam (SRE): I'll add a verification checklist requirement (metrics, smoke test, canary) on the board so owners can't close without proof.
Noor (Infra): I'll prototype a recurrence query and post results in #eng-metrics by Friday.
Priya (PM): I'll update the postmortem template and document the SLA mapping (Sev1=7d, Sev2=21d, Sev3=60d). Plan to roll out next week.
Eli (Oncall): Great. Ping me to chair the first triage.
